QUOTE: "**`deny`** — `ServerManager::execute` returns an error without routing. It is checked after approval" and "Only the deny list can block a call in that setup."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that ServerManager::execute checks is_denied before routing, and that the approval step can't refuse (callback approves unconditionally), so the deny list is the only thing that blocks execution.
